pbr_defect_text: 'Order_Cancel': The design is missing a mechanism for notifying the operator of order cancellations.
'Allocate_car': The parameter types for Allocate_car are is missing in the design (p. 4).
'Order_Cancel': The design states that an order can be cancelled but is missing details on the process (p. 5).
'Allocate_car': The first parameter corresponds to the number on a operator. The second parameter corresponds to a taxi number (p. 4).
'Voice_Msg': The MSC in 4.2 does not clarify conditions for terminating voice messages (p. 10).
'Start_Voice': 'Start_Voice' does not include confirmation handling in the MSC (p. 10).
'Ack': The MSC in section 4.1 is missing a clear acknowledgment for the 'Order' signal (p. 9).
